options.name: account_id
options.description: Account ID or Name of Parent/Source Volume.

options.name: enable_remote_replication
options.description: Flag, whether to replicate the snapshot created to a remote replication cluster. To enable specify 'true' value.

options.name: expiration_time
options.description: The date and time (format ISO 8601 date string) at which this snapshot will expire.

options.name: hostname
options.description: The hostname or IP address of the SolidFire cluster. For na_elementsw_cluster, the Management IP (MIP) or hostname of the node to initiate the cluster creation from.

options.name: name
options.description: Name of new snapshot create. If unspecified, date and time when the snapshot was taken is used.

options.name: retention
options.description: Retention period for the snapshot. Format is 'HH:mm:ss'.

options.name: snap_mirror_label
options.description: Label used by SnapMirror software to specify snapshot retention policy on SnapMirror endpoint.

options.name: src_snapshot_id
options.description: ID or Name of an existing snapshot. Required when C(state=present), to modify snapshot properties. Required when C(state=present), to create snapshot from another snapshot in the volume. Required when C(state=absent), to delete snapshot.

options.name: src_volume_id
options.description: ID or Name of active volume.

options.name: state
options.description: Whether the specified snapshot should exist or not.

options.name: username
options.description: Please ensure that the user has the adequate permissions. For more information, please read the official documentation U(https://mysupport.netapp.com/documentation/docweb/index.html?productID=62636&language=en-US).
